entities.summary: Frances Julia Wedgwood was an English feminist whose writing spanned philosophy, fiction, biography, history, religious studies and literary criticism. She published nearly all of her work either signed as Julia Wedgwood, or anonymously, as was common at the time, except for one early novel under the pen-name Florence Dawson. She was described as "a young woman of extreme passions and fastidious principles" and "at once a powerful reasoner and an inexorable critic of reason".
